ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity bias; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white field across the central and anterior regions. A continuous, irregular black pigmentation band (~15% chord depth) borders the entire trailing edge. A concentrated, low-intensity triangular focal region is present at the median notch. Vertical, low-intensity striae extend from the trailing edge toward the center of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the full extent of the posterior boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) range from 4 to 12 pixels in depth, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly horizontal trailing edges with a slight convex curve leading to sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered, low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) are visible within the white field, primarily concentrated near the trailing edge margins and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) are detected on the left and right lobes, disrupting the white ventral pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring on both lobes; irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge indicates possible minor tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'bleeding' effect where black trailing-edge pigmentation extends into the white field via thin, irregular vertical channels.
